view_frame: Front view (top-left) defines the XZ plane (X width, Z height). Top view (bottom-left) defines the XY plane (X width, Y depth). Right view (bottom-right) defines the YZ plane (Y depth, Z height). The part is a flat bracket with a vertical tab.

features.placement: Base profile in XY plane. Extruded along Z axis from Z=0 to Z=2.0. Profile shape approximates a rectangle with a chamfered top-right corner (visible in Top view).
features.evidence: Top view shows the outline of the main plate. Right view shows the thin profile of the plate.

features.placement: Base profile in XY plane (vertical orientation in Front view). Extruded along Z axis (depth) from Z=0 to Z=2.0. Located at the left edge of the main body (X=0).
features.evidence: Front view shows a vertical rectangular tab on the left. Right view shows the tab extending upwards from the base.

features.placement: Centered at X=15.0, Z=25.0. Extruded through the main body (Z=0 to Z=2.0).
features.evidence: Front view shows a circular hole near the top right. Right view shows the hole location.

features.placement: Centered at X=15.0, Z=5.0. Extruded through the main body (Z=0 to Z=2.0).
features.evidence: Front view shows a circular hole near the bottom right. Right view shows the hole location.

features.placement: Centered at X=15.0, Z=15.0. Extruded through the main body (Z=0 to Z=2.0).
features.evidence: Front view shows a rectangular slot between the two holes.

connections: vertical_tab is fused to the left edge of main_body
top_hole, bottom_hole, and slot are subtracted from main_body
edit_rules: Changing main_body thickness updates the extrusion depth of all features.
Changing hole positions updates the placement of top_hole and bottom_hole.
Changing slot dimensions updates the placement and size of slot.
unresolved: Exact dimensions are missing; ASSUMED values are used for construction.
